mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, persistent inflation triggers monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS up and UNRATE down) fails to produce positive 20d returns in >60% of instances, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth >2.5% and UNRATE <4.5%), a rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals overheating, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, a HOUST rise fails to produce negative 20d returns in >60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE is below 4.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below its 6-month moving average, it signals manufacturing contraction, reducing earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 6-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST up and RSAFS up) fails to produce positive 5d returns in >60% of instances, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS >2.0% and CPIAUCSL >2.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening, an INDPRO decline fails to produce negative 60d returns in >60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03.
